title: Busybox: httpd password rule bypass for pre-compressed .gz files via accept-encoding: gzip
description: CVE-2026-124738 is a vulnerability in Busybox httpd version 3.0 that allows bypassing password rules for pre-compressed .gz files via the accept-encoding: gzip header. The issue relates to improper authentication enforcement when handling gzip-encoded HTTP requests. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
